data.name: Mursalun
data.gender_notes: Mursalun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who goes out to find something, a wanderer, a traveler, a seeker. The name Mursalun carries the meaning “Wanderer, Traveler” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Mursalun usually hope their child will grow to embody wanderer, traveler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who embark on spiritual journeys to find truth and enlightenment
data.etymology: Mursalun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wanderer, Traveler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mursalun total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: مُرْسَلٌ
in_arabic.meaning: أبو الفضل من الرسول، مرسل الرسائل، ناشر الرسالة
in_arabic.long_meaning: المصدر في اللغة العربية مُرْسَلَ، يعني المرسل، المبعوث، الناشر، والمأمور. ويأتي من المادة مَرْسَلَ، التي تعني المأمور، والمرسل. والمرسل في الإسلام يعني المبعوث من الله تعالى، المأمور ببعثة، والرسول من الله. ويعرف المرسل الرسول ببعثته، ويتمثل في الشخصية التي تمتلك صفات الرسالة، وهي العدالة، العفة، والصبر. ويُعتبر المرسل نبيًا أو رسولًا، أو نبيًا ورسولًا، ويعتبره البعض من أهل العلم مُرسَلاً ببعثته، ورسولًا من الله تعالى.

in_urdu.name: مرسلن
in_urdu.meaning: رسول کی صفات کے مالک، پیغام کا بھیجنا، پیغام ناشن
in_urdu.long_meaning: مرسلن کی ابتدا Arabic میں ہوتی ہے جس کا مطلب ہے پیغام کا بھیجنا، یا پیغام کے ساتھ مامور ہونا۔ اس کے معنی میں پیغام بھیجنا، یا پیغام کا بھیجا ہوا شخص ہے۔ اس نام کی اہمیت کی وجہ یہ ہے کہ یہ پیغام کے بھیجنے اور رسول کے معنوں میں سے ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मुरसलुन
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुरसलुन शब्द का अर्थ है अवतरित, प्रस्तुत करना, या किसी भी प्रकार का प्रसारित करना। यह शब्द हिंदू-मुस्लिम सभ्यता के मेल से पैदा हुआ है और मुस्लिम सभ्यता में बहुत महत्व रखता है।

in_pashto.name: مرسلن
in_pashto.meaning: پیغام کا بھیجنا، رسول کی صفات
in_pashto.long_meaning: مرسلن د پښتو کلمه ده چې د پیغام بھیجلو، رسول کی صفات لوړوي، د پیغام کا بھیجلو، یا رسول کی صفات لوړوي.

in_english.name: Mursalun
in_english.long_meaning: Mursalun is an Arabic name that means Messenger, Carrier of Message, or Emissary. It is derived from the Arabic root 'm-r-s-l', which refers to the act of sending or conveying a message. In Islamic tradition, a Mursalun is considered a messenger or emissary of Allah, sent to convey His message to humanity. This name is significant in Islamic culture, as it represents the concept of conveying divine guidance and wisdom to others.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Mursalun" originate from the Arabic root word "Mrs" which means to go out, to travel, and to search. Historically, the name signified a nomadic or traveler lifestyle, a militant man or warrior going to war, or a scholar in search of knowledge. The name has an underlying sense of adventure and exploration, a call to journey and discover new horizons.
data.spiritual_significance: Ultimately, the name "Mursalun" speaks to the fundamental human quest for knowledge, growth, and self-realization. In the Islamic context, the name can be seen as a reminder of the spiritual journey that every person must undertake in order to seek closeness to God and achieve inner peace. It is a reminder that life is a journey, and that each individual must actively seek out guidance, wisdom, and knowledge in order to evolve and grow spiritually. By embodying the spirit of the name and living a life of exploration and continual learning, one can come closer to realizing their true potential and fulfilling their sacred purpose.
